chunks: Safwan ibn Yahya said to Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, peace be upon them:
It has reached me that when a believer is visited by a visitor, he finds comfort in him, and when he departs from him, he feels lonely.
So he said: "He does not feel lonely."

key_terms.الزَّائِرُ: the one who comes to visit
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنَ: the believing person, here referring to the deceased believer

ai.seo_question: Does a deceased believer become lonely when a visitor leaves the grave?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the deceased believer is not left in loneliness when a grave visitor departs. It relates to the condition of the believer after death and touches on the reality of barzakh and visitation of graves.
